data.name: Sanjesh
data.gender_notes: Sanjesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanjeesh is a Hindu name for a boy, derived from the Sanskrit word 'san' meaning 'god' and 'jeshth' meaning 'victorious'. It signifies that the god is victorious and bestows victory and strength upon the one bearing the name. The name Sanjesh carries the meaning “God is victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sanjesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god is victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a boy that embodies the divine power of God and the strength and victory that comes with it.
data.etymology: Sanjesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanjesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
